runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Non-statistical evidence-quality score based on current Historic England, GOV.UK and Planning Data sources, official-register precedence, mapped-extent limitations and strict separation between designation/proximity and development impact on significance or setting.

sources.label: Historic England National Heritage List for England
sources.fact: Historic England describes the NHLE as the only official, up-to-date register of nationally protected historic buildings and sites in England.

sources.label: Historic England Open Data Hub
sources.fact: NHLE listed-building, scheduled-monument, registered park/garden, battlefield, wreck and World Heritage spatial datasets were updated 14 July 2026; conservation-area compilation shown separately with its own update date.

sources.label: Historic England Scheduled Monument Consent
sources.fact: Updated 23 July 2026; written Scheduled Monument Consent is required before most works on a scheduled monument and is separate from any planning permission requirement.

sources.label: Historic England Proposals for Development Management
sources.fact: Historic England identifies consultation/notification cases including specified listed buildings, scheduled monuments, registered parks/gardens, battlefields and certain conservation-area development.

sources.label: GOV.UK Historic environment planning guidance
sources.fact: Heritage significance includes archaeological, architectural, artistic and historic interest and can derive from both the asset and its setting.

sources.label: NPPF Chapter 16 Historic Environment
sources.fact: Applicants should describe significance and setting proportionately; where archaeological interest may exist, the relevant historic environment record and appropriate desk-based/field assessment may be required.

sources.label: Planning Data Archaeological priority area
sources.fact: 796 London archaeological priority areas; collector last ran 26 July 2026, new data 12 May 2026, origin all authoritative sources; APAs represent archaeological interest/potential and use a tiered risk system.

sources.label: Planning Data Scheduled monument
sources.fact: 20,150 scheduled-monument records; collector/new data 24 July 2026; dataset page flags some MHCLG-created data and directs users to the most current Historic England GIS data.

sources.label: Planning Data Listed building
sources.fact: Current readback shows 382,254 records with collector 27 July 2026/new data 25 July 2026; published point location does not by itself define the full affected extent.

sources.label: Planning Data Conservation area
sources.fact: Current readback shows 11,007 areas from 158 providers with collector/new data 27 July 2026; dataset page explicitly notes incomplete coverage and duplicates.

sources.label: Historic England Map Search
sources.fact: Historic England states the map shows locations but not the full extent of structures protected by each listing; the official List Entry must be consulted for extent.

sources.label: Historic England Apply for Listing
sources.fact: Updated 13 July 2026; users are instructed to check whether a place is already listed or under assessment before nomination, reinforcing current NHLE status as the designation authority.

examples.result: LBBD49/XJ remains current; heritage datasets are checked as constraints/context but no designation or setting impact is inferred from candidate proximity alone.
LBBD72/ZZ remains current; archaeological-priority-area membership would trigger evidence needs, not automatic refusal or parcel penalty.
LBBD64/XE remains not-permissioned; heritage context cannot override that status.
LBBD91/DI remains current; official NHLE/List Entry and exact geometry are required before asserting a listed/scheduled relation.
Historic England map markers are not treated as the full legal extent of a listing.
Planning Data scheduled-monument mixed-origin caveat is retained; NHLE/HE data takes precedence where exact designation evidence is needed.
Conservation-area dataset gaps/duplicates prevent negative proof from absence alone.
Archaeological potential requires proportionate HER/desk-based/field evidence where relevant; no parcel score from APA proximity alone.
